headline: As of 2026-10-10: 3,030,986 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+26.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,030,986 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+26.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,306), Florida (490,088), Michigan (346,482).
